title: [Bug] ultrareview timeout shouldn't consume quota credits
body:
**Bug Description**

The remote /ultrareview failed — the cloud session exceeded its 30-minute limit and produced no findings.

Options:
- Retry: run /ultrareview again (you still have 2 free runs remaining this cycle).
- Local fallback: run /review for a local review, or I can scope a focused local audit on the highest-risk areas (e.g. token/cost tracking in v1 vs v2, prompt injection surface, or SSE streaming perf) — narrower scope fits in-session.

Which would you like?

❯ retry, but this is not fair, it is failed why counted me one

Agreed — a failed remote session shouldn't count against your quota. That's a billing issue to report to Anthropic (via /bug or https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues) since I can't refund the counter from here.

To retry, run /ultrareview again in your prompt — it's a slash command I can't invoke on your behalf.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.112
- Feedback ID: ca504692-4d41-4071-974b-3cbd58bad270

top_comments.author: dross50
top_comments.body: +1. First tried /ultrareview, errored saying I had to be on local (I was). Upgraded, then one latent run apparently fired without telling me, I launched one that got killed, fired another that got killed with `Server is temporarily limiting requests (not your usage limit) · Rate limited` / `Turn failed`. Partial findings came back from them before they died. Launch dialog now shows 0/3 free runs remaining, so the failed runs consumed quota.

top_comments.author: astarkov84
top_comments.body:
Same issue here. 2 of 3 free runs consumed by crashes, no findings returned in either case.

**Run 1:** /ultrareview (branch mode)
- Branch: email-campaigns vs master
- Scope: 205 files changed, 10469 insertions(+), 1253 deletions(-)
- Result: Setup ✅, Find ❌ → returned <remote-review>[]</remote-review>
- Session status showed "completed" despite no findings

**Run 2:** /ultrareview 2238 (PR mode)
- Scope: ~66 files changed, 5203 insertions(+), 364 deletions(-)
- Result: Setup ✅, Find ❌ → crashe
